title: RRB Group D 28 Nov 2025 Shift 1 - Mathematics - Time, Speed and Distance
subject: Mathematics

questions.q: Chetan travels from City A to City B. If Chetan drives his car at $\frac{3}{5}$th of his normal speed, then he reaches City B 52 minutes late. Find the time (in minutes) that Chetan would have taken to travel from City A to City B if he drove at his normal speed.
questions.explain:
Let normal speed be $S$ and normal time be $T$.
Since distance is constant, $S \times T = \left(\frac{3}{5}S\right) \times (T + 52)$.
Solving for $T$:
$T = \frac{3}{5}(T + 52)$
$5T = 3T + 156$
$2T = 156 \Rightarrow T = 78 \text{ minutes}$.
